text: The Presbyterian Church (USA) approved a constitutional amendment changing its marriage definition to include gay couples, though not explicitly, after most presbyteries voted in favor. The new language says marriage involves a unique commitment between two people, traditionally a man and a woman, and allows ministers to perform same-sex marriages where legal without forcing them. It takes effect June 21.
